_readme: MASTER PRICE LIST for mirandaraephotography.com. Change a number here, then run `node tools/prices.mjs` and every page (home, Prices page, /book, beach pages, New Booking, /log, llms.txt) is rewritten to match. Keep this matching Miranda's Pixieset Services page.

mini.name: Beach Mini Session
mini.where: Mexico Beach · Port St. Joe · Cape San Blas · Panama City Beach
mini.blurb: Perfect for busy families, couples, or anyone who wants beautiful photos in a shorter, relaxed session.
more: Sunrise, midday or sunset, based on availability

special.name: Beach Special (Classic Session)
special.blurb: Miranda's most popular session, filled with movement, conversation, sandy feet, snack breaks and letting kids be kids.
more: Offered at every beach: no travel fee at Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas & Panama City Beach; $30 travel fee in Destin, 30A & St. George Island

senior.name: Senior Portrait Session
senior.blurb: One last big moment before graduation: relaxed, lightly guided senior pictures on the beach.
more: Bring your cap and gown, letterman jacket, jersey or anything that's you
A few photos with a parent or best friend included
No travel fee at Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas & Panama City Beach; $30 travel fee in Destin, 30A & St. George Island

family.name: Family Session
family.blurb: All about the love, laughter and little moments that make your family yours.

deluxe.name: Deluxe Session
deluxe.blurb: A relaxed session with plenty of time to slow down, move around and enjoy being together.
more: 1 print of your choice mailed to your home

engagement.name: Engagement Session
engagement.blurb: A relaxed, fun session celebrating this exciting chapter together.

proposal.name: Surprise Proposal
proposal.blurb: Your proposal only happens once. Miranda helps plan it, stays out of sight, and captures every emotion.
more: Planning help with location and timing

elopement.name: Beach Elopement
elopement.blurb: A small, relaxed beach ceremony with just your favorite people, photographed from the first look to the last light.
more: Your ceremony, family photos and sunset portraits
Help choosing the spot and timing

wedding6.name: Wedding: Étoile Collection
wedding6.blurb: Six hours of continuous coverage, so your day can unfold without feeling rushed: getting ready, ceremony, newlywed portraits and reception.
more: Full curated gallery, no set photo count

wedding10.name: Wedding: Grand Coastal Collection
wedding10.blurb: The ultimate coastal wedding: every chapter of the day, from getting ready to the very last celebration.
more: Getting ready, ceremony, portraits, family photos, reception and send-off
Full curated gallery, no set photo count

person.name: Extra person (over the package limit)
person.note: Not on Miranda's Pixieset, so it is NOT shown on regular pages, the Prices page, llms.txt or by Sandy. Kept only because the hidden holiday ad pages still mention it (Oct 31 2026).

travelNote: Home beaches (Mexico Beach, Port St. Joe, Cape San Blas, Panama City Beach) have no travel fee. Only Destin, 30A and St. George Island add the $30 travel fee. The $199 Beach Special (Classic) is offered at every beach, home beaches included; the $130 Mini is home beaches only.
